title: Doctorate Recipients from U.S. Universities: 2025 Data Tables
summary: These tables release data from the 2025 Survey of Earned Doctorates (SED), an annual census of research doctorate recipients from U.S. universities. The tables include long-term trend data on doctorate recipients by field; educational pathways to the doctorate and sources of financial support; postgraduation employment plans; and representation of different demographic groups and temporary visa holders among doctorate recipients. Data are also available in an interactive data tool (https://ncsesdata.nsf.gov/builder/sed) and the Restricted Data Analysis System (https://ncsesdata.nsf.gov/rdas/). The SED is sponsored by the National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics within the U.S. National Science Foundation and by three other federal agencies: the National Institutes of Health, Department of Education, and National Endowment for the Humanities.
